title: Irish Pistachio Casserole
description: A delightful twist on traditional casseroles, infused with the nutty flavor of pistachios and the warmth of Irish spices.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until they're tender. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and garlic, cook until softened.
Add flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually pour in milk, whisking continuously. Bring to a simmer.
Stir in pistachios and cook for 2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine cooked potatoes, pistachio mixture, and cheddar cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
